issues.description: Aufgabe 05: The problem statement requests the average area per Landkreis ("durchschnittliche Fläche"), but the solution SQL selects COUNT(flaeche) instead of AVG(flaeche). Problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires an aggregate returning the average area; the solution (solution_repository/aufgabe05.sql) returns a count of non-null flaeche values. This mismatch will produce the wrong metric and confuse students about which aggregate is expected and what the tests verify.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace COUNT(flaeche) with AVG(flaeche) in the solution. Ensure the SELECT returns regierungsbezirk, kreis and the average area and that the GROUP BY and ORDER BY remain correct. Example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, kreis, AVG(flaeche) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk, kreis ORDER BY kreis;
